stem: How does the author's use of language in paragraph 7 contribute to the tone in the selection?

options.label: A
options.text: The words “might also receive credit for their own public work” contribute to a tone of self-interest.

options.label: B
options.text: The words “upholds the key norms of honesty and respect” contribute to a moralistic tone.

options.label: C
options.text: The words “revealing how they have learned from artists who inspired them” contribute to a tone of openness.

options.label: D
options.text: The words “Students do something similar” contribute to an instructional tone.
